messages:
sara: Tagging folks — NovaBank POC reported intermittent decryption failures after we moved traffic through their network appliance. They want a short RCA and whether escrow/hosted-fallback will be billed during the trial.

michael: can you paste the exact error they see? seems like either fragmentation/MTU or wrapped-key mismatch.

drew: pasted from their agent: 
```\n2026-04-01T08:41:02Z ERR decrypt failed cmk=nv-07 err=WRAPPED_KEY_INVALID during session init
2026-04-01T08:41:05Z WARN hsm proxy drop idle=60s conn=pool-3
```

lina: interesting — their appliance is doing SSL reassembly/proxying and might be truncating TLS records when keys are transmitted. also their infra team said they force MSS 1400 on the path.

sara: they imported a BYOK into their Thales HSM and then we received wrapped-key artifacts. works fine for small payloads but fails on 2-3KB requests.

michael: reproduce steps I recommend for them:
1) import key using vendor CLI (thales key-import)
2) run curl with larger payload: `curl -v -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d @big-payload.json https://redwood.example/v1/decrypt`
3) tail our proxy logs and HSM logs to correlate

lina: quick connectivity test for their network team: 
```\npython -c "import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.connect(('hsm-proxy.novabank.internal',1812)); s.sendall(b'A'*2500); print('ok')"\n```

drew: short-term mitigation: 1) enable our hosted fallback route for NovaBank tenant for the POC (non-prod only), 2) ask NovaBank to set path MTU >= 4096 or disable MSS clamping, 3) enable connection keepalive and increase proxy idle threshold to 300s.

finance-bot: Question noted: default policy is to not bill for Marketplace/hosted fallbacks during <30d POC if requested by SE and approved by finance. Need explicit approval for longer duration.

sara: buyer asked about escrow: they want Redwood to hold an encrypted escrow copy for emergency unseal. can we support a sealed-wrapping key stored in their HSM with an emergency access policy?

michael: we can support "customer-managed escrow" pattern: we create the wrapping key in their HSM, we store the wrapped key blobs in Redwood vault but we never hold the unwrapped CMK. Redwood only triggers unseal with a certified runbook and dual-signer approval. This requires SOW addendum.

legal: draft SOW clause sample: "Escrow: Customer elects to enable customer-managed escrow. Redwood will persist wrapped key material encrypted under the customer's sealed-wrapping key. Redwood will only perform emergency unseal upon written authorization from two authorized customer signatories and Redwood SOC contact. Access events will be logged and audited."

lina: another note on rotation windows — NovaBank ops want 3-minute rolling rotations. with current proxy idle/timeouts that will drop inflight tokens. recommend 20m window during POC; we can deliver 3m in production after we deploy session pooling and bump HSM sessions.

drew: technical runbook snippets for their ops (to include in preflight):
- verify HSM firmware >= 4.2 and that vendor supports wrap/unwrap for imported keys
- set MTU >= 4096 on path to hsm-proxy
- allowlist redwood-control-plane IPs: 54.23.11.9/32, 54.23.11.10/32 (example)
- increase HSM session quota to 500 during load tests

sara: can we also provide a 1-page export-control + key-custody statement? their procurement needs it before we run a deeper dry-run.

legal: yes will produce 1-pg kyc + export-control. include: no plaintext key leaves customer HSM, Redwood never imports plaintext, escrow only stores wrapped material.

finance-bot: quick billing note for kevin: if the customer keeps hosted fallback >30 days we'll bill at BYOK-fallback rate + 8h engineering onboarding at standard hourly.

michael: dev note for SEs: small curl to validate header reassembly after MTU fix:
```\ncurl -v -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @big-payload.json https://redwood.example/v1/decrypt | jq .\n```

drew: action items:
- sara: send NovaBank the quick preflight checklist + ask infra to test MTU (ETA: today EOD)
- michael: prepare short runbook & sample SOW escrow language (ETA: tomorrow noon)
- lina: produce short Security slide for their questionnaire covering rotation timing and session-counts (ETA: today)
- legal: deliver 1-pg custody/export statement (ETA: tomorrow)
- finance-bot: confirm POC carveout approval for up to 30d and post here (ETA: 24h)

deploy-bot: note: Hosted fallback route temporarily enabled for tenant=novabank at 2026-04-02T09:05Z by sara. :white_check_mark:

sara: Thanks everyone, i'll loop in the customer's Carla and NovaBank infra lead (Tomas). I'll flag if they want extended fallback beyond 30d.
